# Vendored API documentation assets

The loopback web service self-hosts its interactive API documentation assets so
opening Swagger UI or ReDoc never requires a CDN or other third-party browser
request.

## Swagger UI

- Package: `swagger-ui-dist`
- Version: `5.32.11`
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Upstream package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/swagger-ui-dist/v/5.32.11

Vendored files:

- `swagger-ui-5.32.11/swagger-ui-bundle.js`
  - SHA-256: `fcb81e2c79e7e3b76ddb9bd7fc791552045040fde05c19d3f98f9213e7f7724d`
- `swagger-ui-5.32.11/swagger-ui.css`
  - SHA-256: `ca238f7d7c2cf4480c1e77a9c3b9da915ab216e96ffd354e69076560c650c6de`
- `swagger-ui-5.32.11/LICENSE`
- `swagger-ui-5.32.11/NOTICE`

## ReDoc

- Package: `redoc`
- Version: `2.5.3`
- License: MIT
- Upstream package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/redoc/v/2.5.3

Vendored files:

- `redoc-2.5.3/redoc.standalone.js`
  - SHA-256: `1320f442151c57c447d3b70c7ffc6c4f86d08464020fe34c8cc5d3164e9944f0`
- `redoc-2.5.3/redoc.standalone.js.LICENSE.txt`
- `redoc-2.5.3/LICENSE`

Do not replace these files without reviewing the upstream release, license and
notice material, updating the pinned hashes, and rerunning the web packaging and
security tests.
